locator.identity_review: Telehouse's 1 September 2026 release places Building N on its Frankfurt campus. Telehouse Deutschland's page for the new data centre gives the same figures (about 2,200 m2 of colocation space, 3.6 MW, 4.5 MW total), says it extends Telehouse's own campus and gives the address Kleyerstrasse 75-87, 60326 Frankfurt; its locations page places the Frankfurt campus in the Kleyerstraße, and the December 2023 Building M release describes the same campus and its heat supply to the neighbouring FRANKY quarter, which Mainova's 16 October 2026 article also attributes to the neighbouring Telehouse data centre. The geoportal returns exactly one building-address feature for 'Kleyerstraße 75-87', and each single number from 75 to 87 resolves to that same object, so the range is one registered address. The service's configuration declares EPSG:25832, and the point was transformed with pyproj 3.7.1 (round trip 2 mm). Neither the city centre nor a head-office address is used: the campus address is also Telehouse Deutschland's own, but here it is the published address of the data-centre campus. The 16 October 2026 hold's reference to a former Databurg campus came from trade reporting; Telehouse's own pages place the new building at Kleyerstraße 75-87.
locator.precision: Official City of Frankfurt building-address point for Kleyerstraße 75-87 (address object DEHEFALK4mb00001), the address Telehouse publishes for its Frankfurt campus and its new data centre. It locates the campus at its registered street address, not Building N's footprint, a parcel or the campus boundary.
locator.uncertainty_reason: The address register publishes no positional accuracy. The point is a single address point at the campus street frontage, and Telehouse does not publish where Building N stands on the roughly 67,000 m2 campus.
